name: JG_FSCL_TAX_AUTH_TAXES_INT
description: This interface table contains fiscal document tax information returned by city tax authority. Since city tax authority calculates the city taxes for each fiscal document, this information needs to be captured and stored in the system.

columns.name: TAX_AUTHORITY_RETURN_TAX_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: TAX_AUTHORITY_RETURN_ID
columns.description: Interface identifier of the tax authority event return.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_KEY
columns.description: Fiscal document access key composed by concatenation of fiscal document number and other fiscal document information. It is used as unique identifier for the tax authority system.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_EVENT_CODE
columns.description: Fiscal document event code representing the request that is being made to the tax authority. Possible values are Fiscal Document Status, Cancellation, Void and Contingency.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax code for the classification of a charge imposed by a government through a fiscal or tax authority.

columns.name: TAXABLE_AMT
columns.description: Amount in entered currency on which the tax rate is applied to calculate the tax amount.

columns.name: TAX_RATE
columns.description: Rate specified for a tax status for an effective time period. A tax rate can be expressed as a percentage or a value per unit quantity.

columns.name: TAX_AMT
columns.description: Tax amount associated with the tax distribution.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction code for a geographic area where a tax is levied by a specific tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for the set of tax rules that determines the treatment of one or more taxes administered by a tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Tax status code for the taxable nature of a product in the context of a transaction for a tax.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Tax rate code specified for a tax status for an effective time period, expressed as a percentage or a value per unit quantity.

columns.name: CITY_CODE
columns.description: Unique code provided by the tax authority for a compactly settled area as distinguished from surrounding rural territory.

columns.name: TAX_CREDIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Tax credit amount informed by city tax authority. In some cases, this tax credit amount can be deducted by tax payer from other city taxes.
